question: Sample run: should a solo founder build and sell a paid research tool for developers in 2026?

decision.reversibility: medium: code reusable, public registry reputational tail is not

branches.text: Is the pain already solved? (substitute strength: the native built-in deep-research feature, Elicit, Perplexity)
sub: capability parity of the native built-in deep-research feature
what the rigor layer adds for THIS buyer

branches.text: Will they pay enough? (attach rate to the existing base + standalone conversion)
sub: attach rate of a a paid add-on

branches.text: Can the vendor reach them profitably? (channel: marketplace + owned audience)
Can it be defended? (mechanical honesty gates, registry, base-rate library)
What kills it? (cannibalisation, platform risk, solo maintenance load)

hypotheses.text: Winnable premium wedge: real demand, commodity good-for-gist not for-a-bet
Right engine, wrong package: differentiated but lives as a modest add-on, not a standalone hit
Commodity crush: free deep research already solves it at this buyer's willingness to pay
Channel-starved: good product, fair price, cannot move enough paid units

claims.text: Attach rate of a a paid add-on to the existing buyer base reaches >= 4%
claims.scope: the existing customer base, 12 months post-launch

reference_class.class: add-on attach rates, dev-tool one-time products

claims.falsifier: attach below 4 percent after a full-lifecycle email + site cycle

claims.text: a native built-in deep-research feature is good enough that target buyers will not pay for the rigor layer
claims.scope: developer power users doing venture and market research, 2026

reference_class.class: paid add-ons surviving native feature subsumption, dev tools

claims.falsifier: head-to-head graded run shows no material rigor delta for the buyer's jobs
claims.resolution_source: graded head-to-head vs the native built-in deep-research feature

claims.text: The plugin marketplace plus owned audience can move >= 300 paid units in 12 months
claims.scope: owned channels plus a plugin marketplace, 12 months

reference_class.class: solo-operator dev-tool launches, paid units year one

claims.falsifier: under 75 units in the first quarter post-launch

claims.text: The addressable the platform power-user market exceeds 500k users
claims.scope: weekly active developer power users, global, 2026
claims.resolution_source: Anthropic disclosure or credible third-party estimate
